agents.name: AdCP Protocol Server
agents.description: Official reference implementation of the Ad Context Protocol. Campaign negotiation, deal management, media buy/creative/signals/accounts protocols with Express server, JSON schemas and OpenAPI specs.

agents.name: Prebid Sales Agent
agents.description: Open-source publisher-side AI agent that automates programmatic ad sales. Exposes inventory via MCP, integrates with Google Ad Manager and Kevel. Deploy via Docker in 2 minutes.

agents.name: AdCP Client SDK (TypeScript)
agents.description: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for building AdCP clients and servers. Handles protocol translation, negotiation payloads, and deal state management.

agents.name: AdCP Client (Python)
agents.description: Python library for interacting with AdCP servers. Lightweight client for building buyer agents and campaign automation tools.

agents.name: AdCP Signals Agent
agents.description: Reference implementation of an AdCP Signals Activation agent using MCP. Supports audience signals (demographic, behavioral) and contextual signals (content classification, intent).

agents.name: AdCP Creative Agent
agents.description: Reference implementation of an AdCP creative agent. AI-powered creative generation and optimisation across formats, compliant with the AdCP creative protocol.

agents.name: IAB Buyer Agent
agents.description: AI-powered media buying system built on CrewAI and IAB OpenDirect 2.1. Receives campaign briefs, allocates budget across channels, researches seller inventory, and books deals programmatically.

agents.name: IAB Seller Agent
agents.description: AI-powered inventory management system for publishers and SSPs. Manages seller operations through Claude with 45+ MCP tools. Integrates with Google Ad Manager, FreeWheel, PubMatic, Index Exchange, and Magnite.

agents.name: IAB Agentic Direct
agents.description: Schema-driven A2A + MCP implementation for OpenDirect v2.1. Dual buyer/seller agents with auto-generated tools from OpenAPI spec. JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol for agent communication.

agents.name: Agentic RTB Framework (ARTF)
agents.description: Go/Rust implementation of the ARTF v1.0 spec. Containerised architecture for agent-driven OpenRTB auctions,reduces bid request latency up to 80% by co-locating agents in the same data centre.

agents.name: Agentic Audiences (UCP)
agents.description: Open standard for exchanging privacy-safe audience signals between agents. 128-dimensional embeddings encode identity, contextual, and reinforcement signals. Donated by LiveRamp, governed by IAB Tech Lab.

agents.name: IAB Registry Agent Example
agents.description: ADK TypeScript agent that interacts with the IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry MCP server. Browse entries and search for registered agents programmatically.

agents.name: AAMP Hub
agents.description: Central hub for Agentic Advertising Management Protocols (AAMP). Links to all IAB Tech Lab agentic repos: buyer agent, seller agent, ARTF, agentic audiences, registry, and agentic direct.

agents.name: Amazon Ads MCP
agents.description: Standardised MCP access layer for Amazon Ads. Transforms complex multi-field API operations into conversational queries for campaign data, metrics, and reporting. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry.

agents.name: PubMatic MCP
agents.description: Supply-side platform MCP server for agentic integration. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry with GPP ID verification.

agents.name: Equativ MCP
agents.description: Supply-side platform MCP server for agentic ad serving and inventory management. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry.

agents.name: Optable Audience Agent
agents.description: Privacy-preserving audience infrastructure deployed to private networks. MCP agent for privacy-safe data collaboration and audience activation. Private deployment model.

agents.name: Dstillery MCP
agents.description: Data provider MCP server for audience intelligence and targeting capabilities. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry.

agents.name: Burt Intelligence MCP
agents.description: Analytics MCP server for agentic advertising measurement. Available in EU and US deployments for data residency compliance. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry.

agents.name: HyperMindZ Campaign Orchestrator
agents.description: Manages contractual and operational aspects of media buying. Order management system for campaign orchestration via MCP. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry.

agents.name: Mixpeek MCP Server
agents.description: Data management platform MCP server for agentic advertising infrastructure. Registered in the IAB Agent Registry.

agents.name: IAB Agent Registry MCP
agents.description: Meta-layer MCP server enabling programmatic discovery of all registered agents in the IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry. Query the registry from any MCP-compatible agent.

agents.name: A2A Protocol SDK
agents.description: Official Agent2Agent protocol SDKs (Python, Go, JS, Java, .NET). Enables agents built on different frameworks to discover, negotiate, and collaborate securely. 22.8k GitHub stars.

agents.name: IAB Deals MCP Server
agents.description: Reference implementation for IAB Tech Lab Agentic Task Force. MCP server for programmatic deal management and negotiation.

agents.name: AdTech MCP Suite
agents.description: 10 production-grade MCP servers for advertising technology. Multi-agent hierarchies with Random Forest, Isolation Forest, Thompson Sampling, and Markov Chains.

agents.name: Unified Ads MCP
agents.description: MCP server enabling AI assistants to manage advertising campaigns programmatically across Facebook Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads from a single interface.
